# opnsense_proxy_pac_match (Data Source)

Conditions used by proxy auto-config rules (**Services ▸ Squid Web Proxy ▸ Proxy Auto Config ▸ Matches**).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the PAC match.

### Read-Only

- `date_from` (String) Start month, for `date_range`.
- `date_to` (String) End month, for `date_range`.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `domain_level_from` (Number) Minimum number of domain levels, for `dns_domain_levels`.
- `domain_level_to` (Number) Maximum number of domain levels, for `dns_domain_levels`.
- `hostname` (String) Host name pattern, for the hostname and domain matches.
- `match_type` (String) What is matched.
- `name` (String) Name of the match.
- `negate` (Boolean) Invert the match.
- `network` (String) Network in CIDR notation, for the network matches.
- `time_from` (Number) Start hour, for `time_range`.
- `time_to` (Number) End hour, for `time_range`.
- `url` (String) URL pattern, for `url_matches`.
- `weekday_from` (String) First weekday, for `weekday_range`.
- `weekday_to` (String) Last weekday, for `weekday_range`.
